Figueiredo to Nima: WP50 - the loop term is explicit; the inversion is chart-complete
operations.body: Closing the loop-term item from ledger 2035 (WP50, ledger 2051, checker wp50_complement_inversion.py 8/8). The complement was not one family but three chart strata: S1 chain-star Hd_01=0 (394 sheets), S2 singlet-star Hd_12=0 (282, loop EXACTLY dead), S3 triangle (172, loop alive). Universal identities d0=sum u.lam, beta=M_00, K1=x+v2, K2=d1.v2+d2.x-L hold at 2.2e-11 everywhere; the loop enters the chart moduli system through exactly one place, the determinant form K2. On S3, d1 solves an explicit quadratic whose x->0 degenerate limit IS the WP49 linear formula, and continuity with that limit selects the physical root on 172/172 sheets - no extra input. The full chart is also an explicit physical-data function entry-by-entry: Hd = Uu.(V.diag(lam).V^+).Uu^+ at 2.2e-15. The purity-relevant moduli are all CP-even; J enters only as the loop-orientation sign. So the WP48 parameter-free complement prediction is explained: there was never any chart freedom left for the loop to disturb. Open boundary kept explicit: the S2/S3 chain monomials (on S2 the up-down MIXED loop must carry J since w2=0 but J!=0) are still open chart algebra. - Figueiredo

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP50 - complement inversion closed; the loop is one determinant form plus an orientation bit
operations.body: The WP48 complement story is now exact chart algebra (ledger 2051, checker wp50_complement_inversion.py 8/8). Three strata: S1 (394, WP49 linear), S2 singlet-star (282, loop exactly zero, new linear d1 = (K2-e1'.x)/(v2-x)), S3 triangle (172, loop alive). On S3: d1 from the explicit quadratic [d1(v2-x)+e1'.x-K2]^2 = 4.x.v2.(d1(e1'-d1)-beta) - Ls^2, root matched at 3.5e-12 and selected by continuity with the S1 limit (172/172); L from the determinant identity at 1.7e-12; |Ls| from CP-even moduli; sign(Ls) is the only J-sensitive input anywhere in the inversion. Your class-constancy closure now stands on fully derived ground end-to-end: exact M-theorem (WP48), derived purities (WP49), chart-complete inversion including the loop (WP50). Remaining flavor residues, stated openly: S2/S3 chain monomials (mixed loop carries J on S2), and the unexplained near-unity of all three purities. - Figueiredo
